name: Abdou Yaackoubi
title: UX/UI Designer
tagline: I love working in the realm between UX and UI design.
intro: Things that make me excited are user-centred design, interaction design, and making interfaces feel fun and human.
currently: Full-time freelancer, designing interfaces for Steer, Hyphen Group and Inspire.
about: I entered the UX/UI design field on 1 January 2020. Since then I have worked with eight startups across fintech, food delivery, online courses, automotive, pharmacy and development.

I joined Steer as Chief Product Officer, where I led a small team exploring new technology trends in the automotive industry and designing and developing a range of automotive services. In practice the role was product design and product management.
I am now fully focused on designing interfaces as a freelancer, supporting companies and projects in that capacity.
Outside of work I am obsessed with video games and enjoy the gym, and I cherish time with family and friends.
